title: Two-service capability audit
subtitle: Two services compared across collection, analysis, and delivery.

stages.label: Collect data
stages.optimal: Use Harbor for scheduled feeds and file intake because it covers both collection steps.

stages.label: Deliver results
stages.optimal: Use Beacon for delivery because it sends a clear digest to the chosen destination.

plain.whatItDoes: Collects RSS feeds hourly. It accepts uploaded documents for later processing.
plain.howUsed: A person adds a source or uploads a document. An agent can request the collected items.
plain.unique: It combines scheduled feeds with document intake.

pipeline.overview: Harbor collects sources on a schedule. It stores normalized items for another service to use.

effectiveness.why: It covers both collection paths reliably.

flow.why: Both sources are ready for downstream work.

D1.plain: It collects RSS feeds hourly and retains the latest items.

D2.plain: It accepts documents and records their contents for processing.

D3.plain: It can export results, but it does not send them automatically.

plain.whatItDoes: Builds readable result digests. It sends the digest to a chosen destination.
plain.howUsed: A person selects collected items and requests a digest. An agent can supply the selected items.
plain.unique: It turns selected items into a delivered digest.

pipeline.overview: Beacon receives prepared items. It creates and delivers a digest for review.

effectiveness.why: Delivery is reliable but collection depends on another service.

D2.plain: It accepts prepared text but not source documents.

D3.plain: It creates a digest and sends it to the selected destination.

recommendation.bottomLine: Combine Harbor collection with Beacon delivery. The two services cover the full flow without duplicating collection.

flow.title: Deliver
flow.why: It supplies the strongest delivery step.

nextActions: Connect Harbor output to Beacon input.
